meta.title: maktab365 — textbooks for grades 1–11
meta.description: Read grade 1–11 textbooks online, page by page. Free, for students and teachers.

brand.name: maktab365
brand.tagline: Grade 1–11 textbooks — read online, free, for students and teachers.

hero.title: School textbooks — in one place, free.
hero.subtitle: Find grade 1–11 textbooks by grade and subject and read them online page by page. The page where you stopped is remembered.

items.a: Quickly find the textbook you need by grade and subject.
items.b: Read page by page on a phone or a computer.
items.c: The page where you stopped is remembered.

items.a: Find the textbooks you need for a lesson and collect them with “Save”.
items.b: The page number is in the link: share the exact page with the class.
items.c: Everything is free, no sign-up required.

one.title: Choose a grade and subject
one.text: Find a textbook by grade and subject or search by title.

two.title: Open the textbook
two.text: The textbook opens page by page: turn pages with buttons, arrow keys or by typing a page number.

three.title: Continue
three.text: Your last page is remembered — sign in to continue on any device.

account.a: Not needed. Signing in is optional: it keeps your last page and saved textbooks in your account.

phone.q: Does it work on a phone?
phone.a: Yes. The site is built for phones: swipe to turn pages or use the buttons.

languages.a: The site is in Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), Russian and English. The textbooks themselves are in the language of the uploaded file.
